# thisparam

The goal of thisparam is to provide test specifications as counterparts
to [{checkmate}](https://github.com/mllg/checkmate) assertions.

## Installation

You can install the development version of thisparam from
[GitHub](https://github.com/) with:

``` r

# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("turtletopia/thisparam")
```

# Package index

## All functions

- [`fails_for()`](https://turtletopia.github.io/thisparam/reference/fails_for.md)
  : Test a parameter against failing values
- [`needs_character()`](https://turtletopia.github.io/thisparam/reference/needs_character.md)
  : Test if parameter needs a character vector
- [`needs_flag()`](https://turtletopia.github.io/thisparam/reference/needs_flag.md)
  : Test a parameter that needs a flag
- [`needs_int()`](https://turtletopia.github.io/thisparam/reference/needs_int.md)
  : Test a parameter that needs a single integerish value
- [`needs_integerish()`](https://turtletopia.github.io/thisparam/reference/needs_integerish.md)
  : Test if parameter needs an integerish vector
- [`needs_scalar()`](https://turtletopia.github.io/thisparam/reference/needs_scalar.md)
  : Test a parameter that needs a single atomic value
- [`needs_string()`](https://turtletopia.github.io/thisparam/reference/needs_string.md)
  : Test a parameter that needs a string
- [`needs_vector()`](https://turtletopia.github.io/thisparam/reference/needs_vector.md)
  : Test if parameter needs a vector
